audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed as Job's answer to Bildad: social alienation, God as opponent imagery, plea for pity, desire for words inscribed, goel/vindicator lives, and warning to friends. Goel language is preserved as vindicator/redeemer without forcing later doctrinal readings.

verses.restored: Job answered and said:

familiar.text: Then Job answered and said,

modern.text: Then Job answered:

original.text: וַיַּ֥עַן אִיּ֗וֹב וַיֹּאמַֽר

verses.restored: How long will you torment my soul and crush me with words?

familiar.text: How long will ye vex my soul, and break me in pieces with words?

modern.text: “How long will you torment me and crush me with your words?

original.text: עַד אָ֭נָה תּוֹגְי֣וּן נַפְשִׁ֑י וּֽתְדַכְּאוּנַ֥נִי בְמִלִּֽים

verses.restored: These ten times you have insulted me; you are not ashamed to wrong me.

familiar.text: These ten times have ye reproached me: ye are not ashamed that ye make yourselves strange to me.

modern.text: Ten times now you have reproached me; you shamelessly mistreat me.

original.text: זֶ֤ה עֶ֣שֶׂר פְּ֭עָמִים תַּכְלִימ֑וּנִי לֹֽא תֵ֝בֹ֗שׁוּ תַּהְכְּרוּ לִֽי

verses.restored: Even if I truly have erred, my error lodges with me.

familiar.text: And be it indeed that I have erred, mine error remaineth with myself.

modern.text: Even if I have truly gone astray, my error concerns me alone.

original.text: וְאַף אָמְנָ֥ם שָׁגִ֑יתִי אִ֝תִּ֗י תָּלִ֥ין מְשׁוּגָתִֽי

verses.restored: If indeed you magnify yourselves against me and prove my disgrace against me,

familiar.text: If indeed ye will magnify yourselves against me, and plead against me my reproach:

modern.text: If indeed you would exalt yourselves above me and use my disgrace against me,

original.text: אִם אָ֭מְנָם עָלַ֣י תַּגְדִּ֑ילוּ וְתוֹכִ֥יחוּ עָ֝לַ֗י חֶרְפָּתִּֽי

verses.restored: know then that the Divine has bent me and surrounded me with his net.

familiar.text: Know now that God hath overthrown me, and hath compassed me with his net.

modern.text: then understand that it is God who has wronged me and drawn His net around me.

original.text: דְּֽעוּ אֵ֭פוֹ כִּי אֱל֣וֹהַּ עִוְּתָ֑נִי וּ֝מְצוּד֗וֹ עָלַ֥י הִקִּֽיף

verses.restored: Look, I cry out, Violence, but I am not answered; I call for help, but there is no justice.

familiar.text: Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard: I cry aloud, but there is no judgment.

modern.text: Though I cry out, ‘Violence!’ I get no response; though I call for help, there is no justice.

original.text: הֵ֤ן אֶצְעַ֣ק חָ֭מָס וְלֹ֣א אֵעָנֶ֑ה אֲ֝שַׁוַּ֗ע וְאֵ֣ין מִשְׁפָּֽט

verses.restored: He has walled up my way so I cannot pass, and he has set darkness on my paths.

familiar.text: He hath fenced up my way that I cannot pass, and he hath set darkness in my paths.

modern.text: He has blocked my way so I cannot pass; He has veiled my paths with darkness.

original.text: אָרְחִ֣י גָ֭דַר וְלֹ֣א אֶעֱב֑וֹר וְעַ֥ל נְ֝תִיבוֹתַ֗י חֹ֣שֶׁךְ יָשִֽׂים

verses.restored: He has stripped my glory from me and removed the crown from my head.

familiar.text: He hath stripped me of my glory, and taken the crown from my head.

modern.text: He has stripped me of my honor and removed the crown from my head.

original.text: כְּ֭בוֹדִי מֵעָלַ֣י הִפְשִׁ֑יט וַ֝יָּ֗סַר עֲטֶ֣רֶת רֹאשִֽׁי

verses.restored: He breaks me down on every side, and I go; he uproots my hope like a tree.

familiar.text: He hath destroyed me on every side, and I am gone: and mine hope hath he removed like a tree.

modern.text: He tears me down on every side until I am gone; He uproots my hope like a tree.

original.text: יִתְּצֵ֣נִי סָ֭בִיב וָאֵלַ֑ךְ וַיַּסַּ֥ע כָּ֝עֵ֗ץ תִּקְוָתִֽי

verses.restored: He has kindled his anger against me and counted me as his adversary.

familiar.text: He hath also kindled his wrath against me, and he counteth me unto him as one of his enemies.

modern.text: His anger burns against me, and He counts me among His enemies.

original.text: וַיַּ֣חַר עָלַ֣י אַפּ֑וֹ וַיַּחְשְׁבֵ֖נִי ל֣וֹ כְצָרָֽיו

verses.restored: His troops come together, build up their way against me, and camp around my tent.

familiar.text: His troops come together, and raise up their way against me, and encamp round about my tabernacle.

modern.text: His troops advance together; they construct a ramp against me and encamp around my tent.

original.text: יַ֤חַד יָ֘בֹ֤אוּ גְדוּדָ֗יו וַיָּסֹ֣לּוּ עָלַ֣י דַּרְכָּ֑ם וַיַּחֲנ֖וּ סָבִ֣יב לְאָהֳלִֽי

verses.restored: My brothers he has put far from me, and those who know me are wholly estranged from me.

familiar.text: He hath put my brethren far from me, and mine acquaintance are verily estranged from me.

modern.text: He has removed my brothers from me; my acquaintances have abandoned me.

original.text: אַ֭חַי מֵעָלַ֣י הִרְחִ֑יק וְ֝יֹדְעַ֗י אַךְ זָ֥רוּ מִמֶּֽנִּי

verses.restored: My relatives have failed, and my close companions have forgotten me.

familiar.text: My kinsfolk have failed, and my familiar friends have forgotten me.

modern.text: My kinsmen have failed me, and my friends have forgotten me.

original.text: חָדְל֥וּ קְרוֹבָ֑י וּֽמְיֻדָּעַ֥י שְׁכֵחֽוּנִי

verses.restored: Guests in my house and my slave-women count me a stranger; I have become a foreigner in their eyes.

familiar.text: They that dwell in mine house, and my maids, count me for a stranger: I am an alien in their sight.

modern.text: My guests and maidservants count me as a stranger; I am a foreigner in their sight.

original.text: גָּ֘רֵ֤י בֵיתִ֣י וְ֭אַמְהֹתַי לְזָ֣ר תַּחְשְׁבֻ֑נִי נָ֝כְרִ֗י הָיִ֥יתִי בְעֵינֵיהֶֽם

verses.restored: I call to my servant, but he does not answer; with my mouth I plead to him.

familiar.text: I called my servant, and he gave me no answer; I intreated him with my mouth.

modern.text: I call for my servant, but he does not answer, though I implore him with my own mouth.

original.text: לְעַבְדִּ֣י קָ֭רָאתִי וְלֹ֣א יַעֲנֶ֑ה בְּמוֹ פִ֝֗י אֶתְחַנֶּן לֽוֹ

verses.restored: My breath is strange to my woman, and my appeal to the children of my mother’s womb.

familiar.text: My breath is strange to my wife, though I intreated for the children’s sake of mine own body.

modern.text: My breath is repulsive to my wife, and I am loathsome to my own family.

original.text: ר֭וּחִֽי זָ֣רָה לְאִשְׁתִּ֑י וְ֝חַנֹּתִ֗י לִבְנֵ֥י בִטְנִֽי

verses.restored: Even young children reject me; when I rise, they speak against me.

familiar.text: Yea, young children despised me; I arose, and they spake against me.

modern.text: Even little boys scorn me; when I appear, they deride me.

original.text: גַּם עֲ֭וִילִים מָ֣אֲסוּ בִ֑י אָ֝ק֗וּמָה וַיְדַבְּרוּ בִֽי

verses.restored: All my intimate companions abhor me, and those I loved have turned against me.

familiar.text: All my inward friends abhorred me: and they whom I loved are turned against me.

modern.text: All my best friends despise me, and those I love have turned against me.

original.text: תִּֽ֭עֲבוּנִי כָּל מְתֵ֣י סוֹדִ֑י וְזֶֽה אָ֝הַ֗בְתִּי נֶהְפְּכוּ בִֽי

verses.restored: My bone clings to my skin and flesh, and I have escaped by the skin of my teeth.

familiar.text: My bone cleaveth to my skin and to my flesh, and I am escaped with the skin of my teeth.

modern.text: My skin and flesh cling to my bones; I have escaped by the skin of my teeth.

original.text: בְּעוֹרִ֣י וּ֭בִבְשָׂרִי דָּבְקָ֣ה עַצְמִ֑י וָ֝אֶתְמַלְּטָ֗ה בְּע֣וֹר שִׁנָּֽי

verses.restored: Have pity on me, have pity on me, you my friends, for the hand of the Divine has touched me.

familiar.text: Have pity upon me, have pity upon me, O ye my friends; for the hand of God hath touched me.

modern.text: Have pity on me, my friends, have pity, for the hand of God has struck me.

original.text: חָנֻּ֬נִי חָנֻּ֣נִי אַתֶּ֣ם רֵעָ֑י כִּ֥י יַד אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַּ נָ֣גְעָה בִּֽי

verses.restored: Why do you pursue me like the Divine and are not satisfied with my flesh?

familiar.text: Why do ye persecute me as God, and are not satisfied with my flesh?

modern.text: Why do you persecute me as God does? Will you never get enough of my flesh?

original.text: לָ֭מָּה תִּרְדְּפֻ֣נִי כְמוֹ אֵ֑ל וּ֝מִבְּשָׂרִ֗י לֹ֣א תִשְׂבָּֽעוּ

verses.restored: If only my words were written! If only they were inscribed in a scroll!

familiar.text: Oh that my words were now written! oh that they were printed in a book!

modern.text: I wish that my words were recorded and inscribed in a book,

original.text: מִֽי יִתֵּ֣ן אֵ֭פוֹ וְיִכָּתְב֣וּן מִלָּ֑י מִֽי יִתֵּ֖ן בַּסֵּ֣פֶר וְיֻחָֽקוּ

verses.restored: With an iron stylus and lead, engraved in rock forever!

familiar.text: That they were graven with an iron pen and lead in the rock for ever!

modern.text: by an iron stylus on lead, or chiseled in stone forever.

original.text: בְּעֵט בַּרְזֶ֥ל וְעֹפָ֑רֶת לָ֝עַ֗ד בַּצּ֥וּר יֵחָצְבֽוּן

verses.restored: But I myself know that my vindicator/redeemer lives, and at the last he will stand upon the dust.

familiar.text: For I know that my redeemer liveth, and that he shall stand at the latter day upon the earth:

modern.text: But I know that my Redeemer lives, and in the end He will stand upon the earth.

original.text: וַאֲנִ֣י יָ֭דַעְתִּי גֹּ֣אֲלִי חָ֑י וְ֝אַחֲר֗וֹן עַל עָפָ֥ר יָקֽוּם

verses.restored: After my skin has been thus destroyed, yet from my flesh I shall see the Divine,

familiar.text: And though after my skin worms destroy this body, yet in my flesh shall I see God:

modern.text: Even after my skin has been destroyed, yet in my flesh I will see God.

original.text: וְאַחַ֣ר ע֭וֹרִֽי נִקְּפוּ זֹ֑את וּ֝מִבְּשָׂרִ֗י אֶֽחֱזֶ֥ה אֱלֽוֹהַּ

verses.restored: whom I myself shall see for me; my eyes shall behold, and not a stranger. My kidneys are consumed within me.

familiar.text: Whom I shall see for myself, and mine eyes shall behold, and not another; though my reins be consumed within me.

modern.text: I will see Him for myself; my eyes will behold Him, and not as a stranger. How my heart yearns within me!

original.text: אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֲנִ֨י אֶֽחֱזֶה לִּ֗י וְעֵינַ֣י רָא֣וּ וְלֹא זָ֑ר כָּל֖וּ כִלְיֹתַ֣י בְּחֵקִֽי

verses.restored: If you say, How shall we pursue him? and, The root of the matter is found in him,

familiar.text: But ye should say, Why persecute we him, seeing the root of the matter is found in me?

modern.text: If you say, ‘Let us persecute him, since the root of the matter lies with him, ’

original.text: כִּ֣י תֹ֭אמְרוּ מַה נִּרְדָּף ל֑וֹ וְשֹׁ֥רֶשׁ דָּ֝בָ֗ר נִמְצָא בִֽי

verses.restored: fear the sword for yourselves, for wrath brings punishments of the sword, so that you may know there is judgment.

familiar.text: Be ye afraid of the sword: for wrath bringeth the punishments of the sword, that ye may know there is a judgment.

modern.text: then you should fear the sword yourselves, because wrath brings punishment by the sword, so that you may know there is a judgment.”

original.text: גּ֤וּרוּ לָכֶ֨ם מִפְּנֵי חֶ֗רֶב כִּֽי חֵ֭מָה עֲוֺנ֣וֹת חָ֑רֶב לְמַ֖עַן תֵּדְע֣וּן שדין
